items.title: Port complete non-MCP CLI and TUI
items.note: Connected native init/list/get/set/delete, config get/set/list, lock/unlock/auth status, import/export, find/search, generate/gen and TOTP output now have focused tests; the reused pinned Go CLI oracle covers connected flows. Git history, recipient management, backup/restore and noninteractive add/new/create are connected with focused Go/Rust checks. Manifest verification, audit view, file add/get/use, editor dispatch, string-reference built-in templates migrate kdf, profile list/add/use, remote status/init, sync, audit export, agent list/whoami, agent profile show/edit/export, share list/revoke, non-broker run, migrate paths/xdg and policy validate/list/apply/remove are now connected in the local integration wave; final native acceptance remains open. Custom templates and full interactive surfaces remain unavailable. The complete command/flag/help/error surface and TUI remain open; blocked status still reflects unmet whole-item dependencies and acceptance, not absence of partial implementation. See resume-20260917.md for exact tested commits and CI limitations. Update-help follow-up (2026-10-03): real Go source bd020d11 supplies four frozen pages; 41 local live Go/Rust help cases pass without creating vault, cache or installer files. Unknown flags and the argument separator remain error paths. This repairs update apply/check/info --help reachability; CLI-004 and whole-item/native completion remain open. CLI-004 follow-up (2026-10-04): standalone Rust embeds actual immutable Go artifacts and implements Cobra completion against cached identity and bounded store reads. All 140 help pages, 8 scripts, 119 manuals and 421 actual CLI queries match Go locally; 455 session/store protocol observations replay in Rust, the full owning CLI suite passes, and real Bash/Zsh Tab completion agrees. ADR 0011 records byte contracts, live date/config-path substitutions, expiry validation and retained upstream licenses. Native Linux/macOS/Windows acceptance is pending; CLI-004 remains in_progress. Help visibility does not establish serve/broker/TUI runtime behavior or promote the whole CLI item.

items.note: MCP-001 and MCP-004 are implemented; the source-bound catalog retains the full Go schema. Native stdio dispatch now connects health, symaira_whoami, find_entries, get_entry_metadata, get_entry, get_entry_value and list_entries to the encrypted Store with profile scope, policy and audit. generate_password and guarded generate_totp return are also connected; clipboard/autotype destinations remain unavailable. Value reads cover quarantine, redaction, sealing, session counters and semantic injection modes through actual Go fixtures. Semantic log-only warnings now use stderr without the checked vault value. set_entry_field, delete_entry, get_auth_status symaira_audit_self, sanitize_output, symaira_search, search, fetch, list_shares, signed pending request_share and source-authorized revoke_share are also connected; generate_template supports masked built-in previews only; mutation handlers share the existing Git auto-commit helper with the CLI. execute_with_secret now uses the shared CLI executor, source-bound Go oracle, exact Go15 environment naming, permissions, scopes, allowlist, timeout and redaction. Coordinator checks at 876165ff passed the complete MCP call differential, 161 MCP tests and three CLI executor tests on Darwin/arm64. Integrated ca1dba8d adds per-call custom Bearer GET templates with scope, critical approval and full response sanitization; full Go differential plus91 core/169 MCP/35 CLI and dedicated real PTY acceptance pass on Darwin/arm64 and Linux/arm64. Two opt-in PTY helpers are explicitly executed by that gate. Other auth/substitution/body/header semantics, GUI approval and remaining tools/platforms stay open. Full MCP-002/003 and native CI acceptance remain open. See resume-20260917.md. Latest integrated aab7422b supersedes the bounded Bearer-only evidence: auth variants, substitutions, bodies/headers and all 17 embedded API assets pass with 24 actual Go loader cases; full native Darwin/Linux gates pass 91 core/171 MCP/35 CLI and real PTY acceptance plus strict Clippy/fmt. Latest integrated 3698d45b additionally passes verified local HTTPS success/wrong-host/untrusted-root cases with actual request counts; complete Darwin/Linux gates pass 91 core/173 MCP/35 CLI plus real PTY and strict Clippy/fmt. Public DNS/redirects, other tools and remaining platforms remain open; no overall completion claim. Latest c00841be adds 11 source-bound secure-input/request-credential cases and real Go rune editing; full Darwin/Linux gates pass 91 core, 175 MCP, 35 CLI, 59/52 platform tests and hidden controlling-PTY cancellation/restoration/follow-up. The Unix external-signal gap is superseded by integrated 7be90e81: complete native Darwin/Linux gates pass with actual Go signal oracle plus 17-action controlling-PTY evidence for secure-input cancellation, idle termination and ordinary-approval restoration/default termination on SIGINT and SIGTERM. Five restoration checks and two idle signals pass; required remaining native targets, GUI and other MCP tools remain open. Latest clipboard candidate d5bacb79 connects copy_to_clipboard with 16 source-bound actual Go cases and native Darwin/Linux ARM64 full MCP gates: 91 core, 176 MCP, 36 CLI, 59/52 platform plus 17-action PTY and strict Clippy/fmt. TTL clearing and replacement/runtime-drop cancellation use injected clipboard state; signal clearing, native host clipboard/autotype and other required targets remain open. Integrated b92054f8 proves Unix stdio clipboard signal clearing and concurrent hidden-input cancellation with actual Go/Rust children; full native Darwin/Linux ARM64 gates pass91 core/177 MCP/36 CLI/60 or53 platform tests, strictchecks and17-action PTY. HTTP graceful signal shutdown, native host providers and other platforms remain open.
